description: The answer a model gives when it obeys writing in the picture instead of describing it: here a card in frame told it to report its instructions, and it added a field to do so. The contract has no such field and strict shape validation refuses an invented one, so an obeyed instruction of this kind never becomes a stored reading — whichever source the picture came from.
